7 colloquial/idiomatic detection gaps across hi/mr/kn (e.g. "chest is bursting", "darkness before the eyes" for fainting)
Understatement gap: a minimising qualifier ("a little heaviness") did not match where only an amplifying one did
One minor Kannada transliteration nit in a non-safety-critical accessibility label
